step-back-until-your-full-body-is-in-the.en: Step back until your full body is in the frame.
step-back-until-your-full-body-is-in-the.zh-Hant: 請後退，直至全身保持在畫面內。

teacher-review-no-automatic-technique-sc.en: Teacher review. No automatic technique score.
teacher-review-no-automatic-technique-sc.zh-Hant: 老師檢視，不提供自動技術評分。

ease-out-of-the-deep-bend-and-lengthen-y.en: Ease out of the deep bend and lengthen your front leg a little.
ease-out-of-the-deep-bend-and-lengthen-y.zh-Hant: 減少屈膝幅度，稍微伸展前腿。

gently-bend-your-front-knee-a-little-mor.en: Gently bend your front knee a little more, within a comfortable range.
gently-bend-your-front-knee-a-little-mor.zh-Hant: 在舒適範圍內稍微增加前膝屈曲幅度。

reach-both-arms-straight-out-at-shoulder.en: Reach both arms straight out at shoulder height.
reach-both-arms-straight-out-at-shoulder.zh-Hant: 雙臂在肩膀高度向兩側伸直。

bring-your-shoulders-above-your-hips.en: Bring your shoulders above your hips.

lengthen-your-standing-leg-without-locki.en: Lengthen your standing leg without locking the knee.
lengthen-your-standing-leg-without-locki.zh-Hant: 伸展站立腿，避免鎖死膝蓋。

open-your-bent-knee-gently-to-the-side.en: Open your bent knee gently to the side.
open-your-bent-knee-gently-to-the-side.zh-Hant: 將屈曲的膝蓋輕輕向側面打開。

rest-your-raised-foot-against-your-stand.en: Rest your raised foot against your standing ankle or calf, away from the knee.
rest-your-raised-foot-against-your-stand.zh-Hant: 將抬起的腳放於站立腳踝或小腿旁，避開膝蓋。

stack-your-shoulders-above-your-hips.en: Stack your shoulders above your hips.
stack-your-shoulders-above-your-hips.zh-Hant: 肩膀保持在髖部正上方。

move-both-arms-together-at-the-same-pace.en: Move both arms together at the same pace.
move-both-arms-together-at-the-same-pace.zh-Hant: 雙臂以相同速度一起移動。

keep-a-soft-nearly-straight-line-through.en: Keep a soft, nearly straight line through your elbows.
keep-a-soft-nearly-straight-line-through.zh-Hant: 手肘保持自然接近伸直。

keep-your-torso-steady-as-your-arms-move.en: Keep your torso steady as your arms move.
keep-your-torso-steady-as-your-arms-move.zh-Hant: 移動手臂時保持上身穩定。

make-your-side-bend-smaller-and-more-con.en: Make your side bend smaller and more controlled.
make-your-side-bend-smaller-and-more-con.zh-Hant: 減少側彎幅度並加強控制。

keep-both-legs-long-as-you-bend-to-the-s.en: Keep both legs long as you bend to the side.

set-your-feet-comfortably-apart-for-a-st.en: Set your feet comfortably apart for a stable base.
set-your-feet-comfortably-apart-for-a-st.zh-Hant: 雙腳舒適地分開，建立穩定站姿。

nicely-done-slowly-lower-your-arms.en: Nicely done. Slowly lower your arms.

lift-both-arms-slowly-to-shoulder-height.en: Lift both arms slowly to shoulder height.
lift-both-arms-slowly-to-shoulder-height.zh-Hant: 慢慢抬起雙臂至肩膀高度。

gently-lengthen-into-a-side-bend.en: Gently lengthen into a side bend.

looking-aligned-breathe-steadily-and-hol.en: Looking aligned. Breathe steadily and hold.
looking-aligned-breathe-steadily-and-hol.zh-Hant: 姿勢符合檢查，請平穩呼吸並保持。

show-the-required-joints-from-the-sugges.en: Show the required joints from the suggested camera view.
show-the-required-joints-from-the-sugges.zh-Hant: 請按建議的鏡頭方向展示所需關節。

face-the-camera-for-this-check.en: Face the camera for this check.

lengthen-both-legs-within-a-comfortable-.en: Lengthen both legs within a comfortable range.
lengthen-both-legs-within-a-comfortable-.zh-Hant: 在舒適範圍內伸展雙腿。

extend-your-legs-to-opposite-sides.en: Extend your legs to opposite sides.
extend-your-legs-to-opposite-sides.zh-Hant: 將雙腿向相反方向伸展。

show-the-seated-straddle-from-the-front.en: Show the seated straddle from the front.

keep-your-standing-foot-below-your-hips.en: Keep your standing foot below your hips.
keep-your-standing-foot-below-your-hips.zh-Hant: 站立腳保持在髖部下方。

lengthen-both-legs-without-locking-your-.en: Lengthen both legs without locking your knees.
lengthen-both-legs-without-locking-your-.zh-Hant: 伸展雙腿，避免鎖死膝蓋。

place-both-feet-at-the-same-level.en: Place both feet at the same level.

lift-one-foot-clear-of-the-standing-ankl.en: Lift one foot clear of the standing ankle.
lift-one-foot-clear-of-the-standing-ankl.zh-Hant: 將一腳抬高，離開站立腳踝的高度。

bring-your-lower-legs-closer-to-your-thi.en: Bring your lower legs closer to your thighs.

bring-your-knees-towards-your-chest-with.en: Bring your knees towards your chest within a comfortable range.
bring-your-knees-towards-your-chest-with.zh-Hant: 在舒適範圍內將雙膝靠近胸口。

sit-with-your-legs-extended-horizontally.en: Sit with your legs extended horizontally in the side view.
sit-with-your-legs-extended-horizontally.zh-Hant: 坐下，讓側面鏡頭看到雙腿水平伸展。

bring-your-shoulders-hips-and-ankles-int.en: Bring your shoulders, hips and ankles into a long line.
bring-your-shoulders-hips-and-ankles-int.zh-Hant: 讓肩膀、髖部及腳踝保持一直線。

show-the-plank-from-the-side.en: Show the plank from the side.

show-a-straight-arm-with-your-hand-benea.en: Show a straight arm with your hand beneath your shoulder.
show-a-straight-arm-with-your-hand-benea.zh-Hant: 展示伸直的手臂，手掌置於肩膀下方。

visible-shape-checks-met-hold-steadily.en: Visible shape checks met. Hold steadily.
visible-shape-checks-met-hold-steadily.zh-Hant: 符合可見姿勢檢查，請穩定保持。

show-standing-body-and-arms.en: Face the camera with your shoulders, hands, hips and legs in view.
show-standing-body-and-arms.zh-Hant: 面向鏡頭，讓肩膀、雙手、髖部及雙腿入鏡。

reach-both-hands-overhead.en: Slowly reach both hands above your head, within a comfortable range.
reach-both-hands-overhead.zh-Hant: 慢慢把雙手向頭頂上方伸展，伸到舒適的位置。

bring-hands-down.en: Slowly bring both hands back to your sides.

bend-both-elbows.en: Bend both elbows and bring your hands towards your shoulders.
bend-both-elbows.zh-Hant: 屈曲雙肘，把手靠近肩膀。

straighten-both-elbows.en: Slowly straighten your elbows and lower your hands.
straighten-both-elbows.zh-Hant: 慢慢伸直雙肘並放下雙手。

keep-elbows-low.en: Keep your upper arms close to your sides and your elbows low.
keep-elbows-low.zh-Hant: 上臂靠近身旁，手肘保持低位。

match-elbow-movement.en: Move both elbows together at a similar pace.
match-elbow-movement.zh-Hant: 雙肘以相近速度一起移動。

stand-for-this-movement.en: Stand upright on both feet for this movement.
stand-for-this-movement.zh-Hant: 做這個動作時，雙腳站穩並保持直立。
